title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Location: Hertford
Hours: 35 hours per week
Reporting to: Finance Manager

A well-established, growing organisation based on the outskirts of Hertford is seeking a capable and detail-oriented Finance Assistant to support its finance function. This role would suit someone with some prior office-based experience who is looking to build on their exposure within a finance or accounts environment.

You will play a key role in supporting day-to-day transactional finance activities, ensuring accurate records and smooth processes across the business. Full training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes, ensuring accuracy and appropriate coding.
- Maintaining supplier records and assisting with supplier statement reconciliations.
- Raising sales invoices and supporting credit control activity.
- Assisting with bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Processing staff expenses and monitoring petty cash.
- Updating and maintaining spreadsheets for reporting and tracking purposes.
- Providing general administrative support to the finance team, including filing and record keeping.
- Supporting ad hoc finance and administrative tasks as required.
- Assisting with on-site finance support for events and other ad hoc activities where necessary.

Skills & Attributes:
- Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
- Well organised with the ability to manage and prioritise workload.
- Confident using Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced office environment.
- Reliable team player with good communication skills.
- Professional and proactive approach.

About You:
- 6-12 months' experience in an office-based role (finance or admin exposure advantageous).
- Some exposure to transactional finance tasks would be beneficial but not essential.
- Willingness to learn and develop within a finance function.

What's on Offer:
- Salary up to £30,000 per annum (dependent on experience).
- 35-hour working week.
- 22 days' holiday plus bank holidays.
- Private healthcare.

Interested?

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Invoice & Funding

Potters Bar, EN6 Hybrid Working 34 hour week 26,661 per annum (15.08 per hour)

We're looking for an Accounts Assistant to join a busy team in Potters Bar. This isn't just a data-entry accounts role. You'll be responsible for checking invoices against agreed care plans and funding, identifying discrepancies and making sure the right amounts are being approved for payment.

We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have experience in:
- Care, domiciliary care, healthcare or a care agency environment, particularly where you've dealt with carer or agency invoices
- Accounts payable or finance administration involving high volumes of invoices
- Checking invoices against budgets, agreed funding, purchase information or authorised spend
- Identifying discrepancies and confidently investigating why figures don't match
- Using Excel regularly to manage, check or reconcile financial information

You don't necessarily need to come from a traditional accounting background. If you've worked within care administration and have responsibility for checking agency invoices, hours, rates, funding or budgets, your experience could be highly relevant.

What will you be doing?

You'll be responsible for checking and approving invoices, referring back to care plans and checking for changes such as additional hours, cancelled visits and bank holidays. You'll compare invoices against agreed funding and client contributions and investigate discrepancies directly with agencies or self-employed carers.

You'll also help with:
- Setting up new agencies, carers and reimbursements, ensuring the correct documentation is in place
- Chasing outstanding information where needed
- Responding to accounts queries by email and telephone
- Liaising with the credit controller and account managers where there are funding or invoice queries
- Checking and processing insurance documentation and payments
- Making sure invoice records and folders are accurate and up to date.

Who we're looking for

You'll need to be:
- Very comfortable with Excel and working with numbers
- Accurate, methodical and naturally inclined to spot discrepancies
- Confident questioning an invoice or investigating a mismatch
- Comfortable communicating with agencies, carers, clients and colleagues
- Organised enough to manage a busy workload and multiple queries
- Confident learning and working with an in-house finance system
- Happy working under the watchful eye of the office dog, Teddy!

Location & hybrid working

The office is based in Potters Bar, EN6, with hybrid working available.

Location is important. You'll need to live within a sensible, affordable commute of Potters Bar and be able to attend the office when required. If you're based around Potters Bar, Borehamwood, Barnet, Enfield, Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City or surrounding areas, this could be particularly accessible.

Interested?

If your experience sits somewhere between accounts, invoice processing, care administration and budget/funding reconciliation, we'd really like to hear from you.

description:

Are you an ambitious, organised and forward-thinking individual with a keen eye for detail Do you enjoy working with numbers, supporting a busy finance team and contributing to the success of a growing business

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

Location: Stevenage - Office Based
Salary: 35,000- 40,000 per annum, plus an attractive benefits package and pension
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm
Reporting to: Managing Director
Accounting Software: QuickBooks Online

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, organised and proactive Bookkeeper to join a growing UK business based in Stevenage.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on finance professional to take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration of an SME. Working closely with the Managing Director and liaising with the external accountant, you will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring timely reconciliations and providing reliable financial information to support business decisions.

The ideal candidate will have strong practical bookkeeping experience, excellent attention to detail and recent, hands-on experience using QuickBooks Online. You will be comfortable working independently, investigating discrepancies and ensuring financial records are accurate, complete and up to date.

Key Responsibilities

Day-to-Day Bookkeeping
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records using QuickBooks Online, ensuring all transactions are supported by appropriate invoices, receipts and documentation.
- Process supplier invoices, expenses, customer invoices and credit notes accurately.
- Apply appropriate account codes and VAT treatments, referring complex or unfamiliar matters to the external accountant where necessary.
- Review bank feeds, match transactions and ensure duplicate entries are avoided.

Banking and Payments
- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and other relevant accounts regularly, completing formal month-end reconciliations.
- Investigate discrepancies, resolve errors and maintain a clear audit trail.
- Prepare supplier payment schedules and payment batches for approval.
- Follow established financial controls, including expenditure approval procedures and verification of supplier bank details.

Sales and Purchase Ledgers
- Maintain accurate customer and supplier accounts and balances.
- Allocate customer receipts and supplier payments, reconcile supplier statements and resolve account queries.
- Monitor overdue customer accounts and undertake appropriate credit-control activities.
- Prepare clear aged debtor and creditor reports.

Month-End and Financial Reporting
- Complete the agreed month-end checklist and investigate unusual or unexplained balances.
- Produce routine profit and loss, balance sheet and cash-position reports.
- Highlight significant financial movements, overdue debts and upcoming payment requirements to management.
- Prepare supporting schedules and financial information for the external accountant.
- Assist with year-end preparation and respond to accountant queries.

VAT and Financial Administration
- Prepare VAT returns and supporting reconciliations for review and submission, where authorised.
- Maintain organised digital financial records and promptly identify missing documentation.
- Ensure financial information is accurate, complete and readily accessible.
- Identify opportunities to improve bookkeeping processes, reporting and financial controls.

Payroll

Payroll responsibilities will depend on the final scope of the role. These may include preparing payroll inputs for an external provider, checking approved payroll changes, reviewing payroll outputs, maintaining confidential records and coordinating payroll-related reporting and payments.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Demonstrable experience maintaining the books of a UK business with a comparable volume and complexity of transactions.
- Recent, practical experience using QuickBooks Online, including bank feeds, reconciliations, customer and supplier accounts, VAT reporting and standard financial reports.
- A sound understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and the relationship between the profit and loss account and balance sheet.
- Working knowledge of routine UK VAT treatment and the documentation required to support financial entries.
- The ability to investigate discrepancies and complete reconciliations independently.
- Competent Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, basic formulas and reconciling data.
- Excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines reliably.
- Clear and professional communication skills, with the confidence to liaise with colleagues, customers, suppliers and external accountants.
- A responsible approach to handling confidential financial information.

A relevant AAT, ICB or equivalent qualification would be advantageous. However, candidates with strong, demonstrable practical bookkeeping experience will also be considered.

Desirable Experience

The following would be beneficial but are not essential:
- QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.
- Payroll administration experience, depending on the agreed responsibilities.
- Experience improving bookkeeping processes or bringing financial records up to date following a backlog.
- Cash-flow reporting and credit-control experience.
- Experience within a similar business environment.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for a self-starter who takes ownership of their work and can manage day-to-day responsibilities with minimal supervision.

You will be highly organised, dependable and methodical, with the confidence to ask questions when information is missing or a financial treatment is uncertain. You will communicate issues promptly, exercise sound judgement and understand when management approval or specialist advice is required.

Above all, you will take pride in maintaining accurate financial records and providing a reliable, professional bookkeeping service to the business.

Salary and Benefits

The successful candidate will receive a competitive salary of 35,000- 40,000 per annum, alongside an attractive benefits package, including:
- 25 days' annual leave, including a business shutdown over the Christmas period.
- Pension scheme.
- Life assurance.
- Healthcare.
- Income protection, including critical illness cover.
- Free on-site parking.

How to Apply

If you are an experienced Bookkeeper with strong QuickBooks Online skills and are looking for a permanent, office-based role where you can take ownership of the finance function within an established SME, we would welcome your application.

Please submit your CV for consideration.

title: XERO BOOKKEEPER
description:
An established and growing business operating within the construction sector is seeking an experienced Xero Bookkeeper to support its finance function. This is a varied, hands-on role offering responsibility for the day-to-day bookkeeping activities, payroll, CIS returns and elements of management reporting.

Reporting directly to the Financial Controller, the successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring the smooth running of the company's accounting processes.

Key Responsibilities
- Sales Ledger: Managing customer invoicing, monitoring outstanding debts and maintaining accurate sales ledger records.
- Purchase Ledger: Processing supplier invoices, reconciling supplier statements, preparing payment runs and resolving invoice queries.
- Bank Reconciliations: Completing regular bank reconciliations and ensuring transactions are accurately recorded.
- Payroll: Processing payroll accurately and on time, ensuring all relevant deductions and submissions are completed.
- CIS Returns: Preparing and submitting Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) returns, including verifying subcontractors and ensuring compliance with HMRC requirements.
- Management Reporting: Assisting with the preparation of management reports, financial analysis and other reporting requirements.
- Month-End Support: Assisting with month-end procedures, reconciliations and the preparation of financial information for review.
- Financial Administration: Maintaining accurate records, supporting the Financial Controller with ad hoc financial tasks and identifying opportunities to improve processes.

The successful candidate will have:
- Strong, hands-on experience using Xero, with the ability to manage day-to-day bookkeeping independently.
- Previous experience managing both sales and purchase ledgers.
- Experience processing payroll and preparing CIS returns.
- A good understanding of bookkeeping principles, bank reconciliations and financial controls.
- The ability to assist with management reporting and month-end processes.
- Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to financial administration.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- A proactive attitude, with the confidence to work independently while supporting the wider finance team.

Previous experience within the construction, would be advantageous, particularly familiarity with CIS requirements.

This is an excellent opportunity for a capable Xero Bookkeeper seeking a broad, hands-on position within a growing business.
